name: News Reporting
description: Gathering, verifying, and writing news for publication.

name: News Writing
description: Crafting accurate, concise, and structured news stories.

name: Feature Writing
description: Writing longer narrative and human-interest stories beyond hard news.

name: Interviewing
description: The techniques of eliciting information and quotations from sources.

name: Beat Reporting
description: Reporting on an assigned topic or institution over time to build expertise.

name: News Editing
description: Reviewing, revising, and preparing stories for publication.

name: Copy Editing
description: Correcting and polishing copy for grammar, style, accuracy, and clarity.

name: Headline Writing
description: Writing accurate, compelling headlines that summarize stories.

name: Newsroom Management
description: Leading and organizing the editorial operations of a news organization.

name: Investigative Journalism
description: In-depth reporting that uncovers wrongdoing, often through documents and analysis.

name: Data Journalism
description: Journalism that finds and tells stories through the analysis of data.

name: Computer-Assisted Reporting
description: Using computing and databases to support reporting.

name: News Data Visualization
description: Presenting data graphically to reveal patterns and support stories.

name: Broadcast Journalism
description: Journalism delivered through television and radio.

name: Television Journalism
description: News reporting and production for television.

name: Radio Journalism
description: News reporting and production for radio.

name: Digital Journalism
description: Journalism produced for and distributed through digital platforms.

name: Online Journalism
description: Journalism native to the web, including hypertext and interactivity.

name: Mobile Journalism
description: Reporting, filming, and publishing using mobile devices.

name: Social Media Journalism
description: Gathering and distributing news through social platforms.

name: Multimedia Journalism
description: Storytelling that combines text, audio, video, and graphics.

name: Photojournalism
description: Telling news stories through still photography.

name: Journalism Ethics
description: The principles of accuracy, fairness, independence, and accountability in journalism.

name: Accuracy and Verification
description: The obligation to verify facts and correct errors.

name: Source Protection
description: Protecting the confidentiality of sources and handling anonymity.

name: Conflict of Interest
description: Avoiding relationships and interests that compromise journalistic independence.

name: Fact-Checking
description: Systematically verifying the truth of claims, especially in public discourse.

name: Media Law
description: The legal rules governing publication, speech, and journalism.

name: Defamation Law
description: The law of libel and slander protecting reputation against false statements.

name: Freedom of the Press
description: The legal and constitutional protections for independent journalism.

name: Privacy and Journalism
description: The balance between the public interest and individuals' privacy rights.

name: Journalism by Beat
description: Journalistic specializations defined by the subject matter they cover.

name: Political Journalism
description: Reporting on government, elections, and political affairs.

name: Business Journalism
description: Reporting on companies, markets, and the economy.

name: Sports Journalism
description: Reporting on sports, athletes, and competitions.

name: Science Journalism
description: Reporting on scientific research and discovery for general audiences.

name: Health Journalism
description: Reporting on medicine, health policy, and public health.

name: Environmental Journalism
description: Reporting on the environment, climate, and conservation.

name: Community Journalism
description: Reporting focused on a specific local community.

name: International Journalism
description: Reporting on foreign affairs and global events.

name: Conflict Journalism
description: Reporting from war zones and conflicts.

name: Development Journalism
description: Reporting oriented to development goals and social change, rooted in the Global South.

name: Opinion Journalism
description: Journalism expressing viewpoints, analysis, and argument distinct from news reporting.

name: Editorial Writing
description: Writing the institutional opinion of a publication.

name: Column Writing
description: Writing recurring opinion pieces from a personal perspective.

name: Criticism
description: Reviewing and critiquing the arts, culture, and media.
